title: Spacious 3BR Nashville Home • Sleeps 6 • Parking
description:
Welcome to our comfortable 3-bedroom Nashville home, perfect for families or small groups visiting Music City. 

Located ~15 minutes from Broadway & Downtown, the home offers easy access to restaurants, live music, and attractions while still being in a quieter neighborhood. 

Guests can relax on the covered side porch after exploring the city. 

Sleeps 6 guests with 3 queen beds, plus a full kitchen, laundry, and free parking. 

Best suited for respectful guests — no parties or loud gatherings.

The space
What You'll Love:

🛏 3 Bedrooms — each bedroom features a comfortable queen bed and convenient USB charging stations

🛁1 Full Bathroom — centrally located and easily accessible from all three bedrooms, making it convenient for groups while keeping the layout simple and easy to navigate.

🍳 Fully Equipped Kitchen — cookware, utensils, full-size refrigerator, and coffee provided 

🛋 Comfortable Living Room — flat-screen TV with Roku/app streaming (no cable)

🧺 In-Unit Washer & Dryer — pack light and refresh clothes during your stay

🚗 Off-Street Parking — space for up to 2 cars

☕Outdoor Space — Relax on the covered side porch, a perfect place to enjoy morning coffee or unwind in the evening after exploring Nashville.

🏡 Charming 1930s Character — original hardwood floors, large windows, and plenty of natural light

📍 Local Recommendations — curated list of Nashville restaurants and local favorites provided

🛏 Fresh Linens & Towels — professionally cleaned and ready for every guest

🏙️Location
Conveniently located with easy access to Nashville's most popular destinations:
• 15 minutes to Broadway / Downtown Nashville
• 10 minutes to East Nashville restaurants and bars
• 15 minutes to Nissan Stadium
• Quick Uber or Lyft rides to concerts, nightlife, and events

ℹ️ Note: This home is the main level of a duplex. A tenant lives in the upstairs apartment with a separate entrance.

✨Good Fit For — This home is ideal for guests looking for a comfortable, relaxed Nashville stay close to the action but in a quieter residential setting. 

Because the property is part of a duplex with a separate upstairs apartment, quiet hours are observed from 10 PM – 8 AM to ensure a peaceful stay for everyone.

Guest access
You’ll have the entire home to yourself during your stay.

Check-in is simple and convenient with a secure key lockbox. Full arrival instructions, including the address and entry code, will be sent to you a few days before your check-in.

If you have any questions before or during your stay, we’re always happy to help.

Other things to note
📍Location
• About 15 minutes to Broadway / Downtown Nashville
• 10 minutes to East Nashville restaurants
• 15 minutes to Nissan Stadium
• Easy Uber/Lyft access to nightlife and concerts

✅ Good to Know
• Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM
• No parties or loud music
• Check-in: 4 PM
• Check-out: 10 AM
• Late check-out without approval: $100/hr
• Flexible times may be available if scheduling allows
• Fully licensed Metro STR permit displayed
